passed_boundaries: support_sign is exactly positive-plane followed by equal-size negative-plane
bit offset, negative sign, and nonzero padding attacks are rejected
D0/D2/D3 exact +0/+1 and D1 dynamic positive-finite theta checks work
a D1 all-zero call is not coerced to one and a multi-theta call is rejected
global samples 10 through 39 project to exactly 120 calls in the positive control
zlib trailing data and raw FP32 SHA drift are rejected
four-weight key/checkpoint positive and negative controls work except exact bool ordinal
the CLI exposes no production-replay mode and all performance claims remain false

findings.evidence: A D1 row in global sample 10 can reuse the D0 global_order and the adapter still returns 120 calls.
findings.repair: An additive successor must require each of all 9880 rows to have type(global_order) is int and global_order equal to its JSONL file ordinal 0..9879.

findings.evidence: An ignored row can be replaced with a duplicate while preserving 9880 rows and the projection passes.
findings.repair: The same exact global_order-to-file-ordinal invariant must close duplicate/replacement aliases before decoder projection.

findings.evidence: module_ordinal=true is accepted for D1 because Python bool equals integer one.
findings.repair: An additive successor must require type(module_ordinal) is int before ordinal equality.
